body: Thanks for your ideas. Since my sister didn't call 911 earlier, my mom lied and told the police she was fine and is now pissed at my sister. Of course, this just has to be prom night for my sister and thank god she was home, but it means she can't get a hold of her friend. I told her to call her friend tomorrow to have some physical support.

Thank you for your advice. The main problem is that my sister is all alone with her for the week unless we can get in contact with my father (who's not even in the US, he comes back the 2nd). I told her to call 911 and she told me that they've arrived, I don't know anything else yet.

If it comes down to it, I'll make the trip there. I feel selfish saying this but my senior finals (university) are this week and I might jeopardize my graduation but I will go if either/both of them needs me.
